ctx.x: I think what happened -- if I remember the story correctly, is that the band was playing in Texas, and there was somebody there giving free lung X-rays at the hotel where the band was, and so I think Duke had everybody go get one, because, you know, Duke was always so health concious, and it turned out that Cootie's X-Ray showed that he had TB, and so he left the band and rested for awhile, and then I think he played briefly with Mercer after Duke died; I'm not sure, but now he's not working at all.

I visited Al Sears and his wife when I was in New York last summer, and Cootie lives near them, and he said that Cootie and his wife went to the race track every day, and just enjoyed life, and relaxed -- and that he doesn't work because he doesn't want to, and he's doing very well.
Oh? I imagine he don't play that much.
